candidate.rank: nearest integer inverse NTO weight purity; maximum four

anchor_energy.recalibrate: full AO-pair F and qualified-spectral Q response, bare projected ERIs, three S0 minima
anchor_energy.target: original unscaled anchor for every recalibrated model
anchor_energy.relative_frame: metric-polar transport of original full active Gram matrix

anchor_energy.rank: recomputed and required to agree; rank changes reported separately

independent.labels: segregated until every prediction attempt closes
independent.exposure_audit: repeat against newer result trees before accepting independent designation
independent.CT_shortfall: no eligible CT state in this small unused cohort; no general CT validation claim
independent.assignment: reference same-symmetry ordinal and transition identity; never reference energy proximity

structure_frequency.reference: published CC2/CCSD structures and harmonic frequencies if state and geometry correspondence can be certified; otherwise independent CC2 reference required
structure_frequency.frequency_reporting: project rigid translations/rotations; compare harmonic to harmonic; retain imaginary modes

cost.TDA: same native/corrected GFN2 orbitals and kernel; include stationary ground preparation; all roots versus one OO state explicitly distinguished

cost.no_tda_derivative_implementation: mark unavailable; finite-difference estimate only if actually measured

reporting: Only completed certified results enter manuscript; pending work and limits remain explicit. All attempts preserved.
